issues.location: body paragraph starting “旧习难改，所以我预期今天许多巨头…”
issues.problem: “A.I. 冷呼叫智能体” reads like a literal technical calque in Chinese. The intended meaning is cold-call AI agents, closer to “A.I. 陌生外呼智能体” or “A.I. 电话销售智能体”.
issues.suggestion: Consider changing the link text to “A.I. 陌生外呼智能体” for a more natural Chinese technical/business register.

issues.location: bullet list item “联网获取最新代码库”
issues.problem: “code libraries” is translated as “代码库”, which can be read as repositories rather than libraries/packages/docs. The meaning is understandable but slightly imprecise.
issues.suggestion: Use “联网获取最新代码库/库文档” or “联网获取最新开发库信息” if editing later.

reviews.notes: The translation reads as fluent Mandarin technical essay prose rather than sentence-by-sentence English transfer. It preserves Ernie’s blunt, playful voice, keeps product/code terms appropriately, translates reader-facing alt text and captions, and the MDX/frontmatter are not broken.

issues.problem: “打造 A.I. 原生产品和……”保留了英文标题的截断感，但中文里“和……”显得比英文更像机器漏译，标题力度偏弱。若源标题确实只有截断省略号，可接受。
issues.suggestion: 可考虑更自然地保留悬念，如“给人用的 A.I.：打造 A.I. 原生产品，以及……”

issues.location: bullet: Up-to-date code libraries with access to the internet
issues.problem: “联网获取最新代码库”容易被读成 repositories/codebase，而 source 的 code libraries 更接近依赖库/程序库。
issues.suggestion: 改成“联网获取最新程序库信息”或“可联网查询最新库文档”。

issues.problem: “A.I. 冷呼叫智能体”是偏直译的技术营销腔，中文读者更自然理解为陌生电话/外呼。
issues.suggestion: 改成“A.I. 陌生外呼智能体”或“A.I. 电话外呼智能体”。

reviews.notes: 整体不是逐句硬译：多处把英文口语、玩笑和长句改写成自然中文节奏，如“不怎么靠谱”“扯头发和砸键盘”“野到不行”，同时保留了 Ernie 的技术口吻和 A.I. code-switching。MDX 与人类可见文本基本完整，只有少量术语和标题可再润色。
